# PH-Composer API reference

Generated from the registered declarations. Do not edit by hand: `make fixtures` rewrites
this page, and the offline suite fails when it is stale. [API_QUICKSTART.md](API_QUICKSTART.md)
walks through one session from discovery to a verified edit.

Every name below is what `PhComposer::API.describe(name:)` answers for. Params and results are
JSON Schema; a number's `x-unit` is the SI unit it is stored and exchanged in. Every call except
`discover`, `describe` and `connect` answers with one outcome shape:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | `completed`, `refused`, `failed`, `busy`, `pending` or `cancelled` |
| `code` | `ok`, or why the request did not complete, such as `revision.stale` or `target.changed` |
| `effect` | What happened to the Model: `none`, `committed`, `rolled_back` or `unknown` |
| `revision` | The Model revision after the call; send it back as `expected_revision` |
| `value` | The operation's result, described below as its result schema; absent unless completed |
| `affected` | Each record an action changed: `kind`, `id`, `change` and, for entities, `reference` |
| `findings` | Advisory rows the operation reports without refusing |
| `detail` | Structured data a caller needs to act on a refusal |
| `proposal_digest` | From a preview; send it with the invoke to refuse if the change is no longer the same |

A refused or failed action leaves the Model unchanged unless `effect` says otherwise. An action
whose value would change nothing completes with `effect` `none` and no Undo step.

## Record kinds

A catalog kind is stored in the Model's own records and read through `ph_composer.records.list`. An entity kind is stored on SketchUp geometry and read through its owner's queries; its writes are its owner's actions.

### `ph_composer.spaces.space`

Space, a entity kind owned by `ph_composer.spaces`, schema version 1.

Values:

```json
{
  "type": "object",

  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "number": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "default_height_m": {
      "type": "number",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
      "x-unit": "m",
      "description": "The height a new Volume takes."
    },
    "next_volume_sequence": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "v_sup_m3h": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0,
      "x-unit": "m3/h",
      "description": "Supply airflow. Absent is unset, distinct from 0."
    },
    "v_eta_m3h": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0,
      "x-unit": "m3/h",
      "description": "Extract airflow. Absent is unset, distinct from 0."
    },
    "v_tran_m3h": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0,
      "x-unit": "m3/h",
      "description": "Transfer airflow. Absent is unset, distinct from 0."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.spaces.volume`

Volume, a entity kind owned by `ph_composer.spaces`, schema version 1.

Values:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "number",
    "display_name",
    "floor_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "number": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "avg_ceiling_height_m": {
      "type": "number",
      "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
      "x-unit": "m",
      "description": "Average clear ceiling height; absent until entered."
    },
    "floor_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^flr_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The logical Space Floor's id."
    },
    "home_transform": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "number"
      },
      "minItems": 16,
      "maxItems": 16,
      "description": "The Volume's transform relative to its Space at the last reconcile, for Restore position."
    }
  }
}
```

References: `building_segment_id` names one `ph_composer.zones.building_segment`; `level_id` names one `ph_composer.zones.level`.

Values:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "name",
    "ground_depth_mm"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "building_segment": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "level": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "ground_depth_mm": {
      "type": "number",
      "x-unit": "mm"
    },
    "building_segment_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "level_id": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Occurrence reference:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "zone_id",
    "zone_path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "zone_id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "zone_path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Common refusals

Every operation answers the codes of its kind's set besides its own, and an operation that needs the user to choose a location also answers the `approval` set. Each operation below lists only its own codes. `PhComposer::API.discover` returns these sets as `common_refusals`, and `describe` returns an operation's own codes as `refuses` and the sets it answers as `common_refusal_sets`. Every refusal has `code`, `owner` and `description`; the foundation's description is null. Discovery's `refusal_documentation` points to [Outcomes and codes](https://github.com/ph-composer/ph-composer-skp/blob/main/context/CONTRACTS.md#outcomes-and-codes).

| Set | Codes |
| --- | --- |
| `query` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed` |
| `action` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed`, `request.pending`, `request.sequence_conflict`, `request.outcome_unavailable`, `revision.stale`, `proposal.changed`, `operation.rollback_unverified` |
| `view_command` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed` |
| `setup_command` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed` |
| `file_export` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed` |
| `participant` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed`, `operation.proposal_required`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `proposal.contribution_replaced` |
| `approval` | `access.user_required`, `request.cancelled` |
| `location` | `location.unknown`, `location.revoked`, `location.used`, `location.kind_mismatch`, `location.unavailable`, `location.setup_unreadable`, `location.setup_unavailable` |

## Queries

Called with a context granted `read`.

### `ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.all`

The complete assemblies inventory for the panel snapshot. Owner: `ph_composer.assemblies`.

Unbounded: answers the whole Model in one result. A client with a reply budget reads `ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.list` instead.

Refuses: only the `query` common set.

### `ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.list`

One bounded page of assemblies, with display findings. Owner: `ph_composer.assemblies`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "maxItems": 500,
      "description": "Only these record ids; every record when absent."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."

  }
}
```

```json
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "outcome",
              "candidates"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "outcome": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [

                  "reuse",
                  "review_required",
                  "ambiguous_source",
                  "ambiguous_name"
                ]

              "candidates": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "additionalProperties": false,
                  "required": [
                    "id",
                    "display_label",
                    "differences",
                    "expected_values",
                    "comparison_available",
                    "source_changed"
                  ],
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "display_label": {
                      "type": [
                        "string",
                        "null"
                      ],
                      "description": "The local record's label; null when it has none."
                    },
                    "differences": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "additionalProperties": false,
                        "required": [
                          "field",
                          "local",
                          "incoming",
                          "local_present",
                          "incoming_present"
                        ],
                        "properties": {
                          "field": {
                            "type": "string"
                          },
                          "local": {
                            "type": [
                              "string",
                              "number",
                              "boolean",
                              "object",
                              "array",
                              "null"
                            ]
                          },
                          "incoming": {
                            "type": [
                              "string",
                              "number",
                              "boolean",
                              "object",
                              "array",
                              "null"
                            ]
                          },
                          "local_present": {
                            "type": "boolean"
                          },
                          "incoming_present": {
                            "type": "boolean"
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    },
                    "expected_values": {
                      "type": "object"
                    },
                    "comparison_available": {
                      "type": "boolean"
                    },
                    "source_changed": {
                      "type": [
                        "boolean",
                        "null"
                      ]
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "total": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Rows matching the filter, on every page."
    },
    "next_cursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Pass back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.spaces.candidate_faces.list`

One page of the Faces of one Space or one Volume that carry no record yet: Floor candidates inside a Volume (for floors.mark) and loose Faces at the Space's root (for volumes.create), each with the refusal its operation would give now. Name exactly one. Owner: `ph_composer.spaces`.

Refuses: `geometry.invalid`, `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.changed`, `target.not_found`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

```json
          "type": "array",

}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.types.list`

A bounded page of types with display findings. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, and the `query` common set.

### `ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.layers.flip`

### `ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.segments.set_material`

### `ph_composer.library.copy`

Copy or reuse one library record with optional assignment. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Undo step: Copy Library Record. Copies or replaces local definitions and optional assignments in one Undo step.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.callback_invalid`, `library.catalog_stale`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.local_choice_required`, `library.provider_ambiguous`, `library.provider_failed`, `library.provider_invalid`, `library.provider_unavailable`, `library.review_required`, `library.row_semantic_invalid`, `library.row_unavailable`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "provider_id",
    "kind",
    "generation",
    "library_id",
    "record_id",
    "choice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "provider_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "A configured library, by the id ph_composer.library.providers lists."
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library kind, such as materials or frames; providers lists the kinds each library serves."
    },
    "generation": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The catalog generation the caller read. Omit it to use the current one; a stale one is refused as library.catalog_stale."
    },
    "library_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library holding the row, as the catalog row gives it."
    },
    "record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The row's record id within that library."
    },
    "choice": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "create",
        "keep_local",
        "use_library"
      ],
      "description": "create copies the row as a new local record; keep_local reuses a reviewed local candidate unchanged; use_library replaces a reviewed candidate's values with the library's. Read the resolution first with in_file or a preview."
    },
    "local_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The reviewed local candidate for keep_local or use_library, from the resolution's candidates. May be omitted when there is exactly one."
    },
    "expected_values": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "For use_library: the candidate's expected_values from the resolution. Refused when the local record changed since."
    },
    "assignment": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional: where the owning feature also assigns the copied record, in that kind's assignment target shape, such as one Window Type element side."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
        ],

            "type": "string"
          },
```

### `ph_composer.spaces.update_metadata`

Undo step: Edit Space Metadata. Rewrites only the named records' metadata.

```json
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "minItems": 1,
                "description": "The root-to-entity persistent-id path."
              }
            },
            "description": "The occurrence to update, as a read returns it."
          },
          "user_data": {
            "type": "object",

          },
          "extension_payloads": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "object"
            },
            "description": "Replaces the payload of each named installed extension."
          },
          "expected_metadata": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "user_data",
              "extension_data"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "user_data": {
                "type": "object"
              },
              "extension_data": {
                "type": "object"
              }
            },
            "description": "The user_data and extension_data last read; a change refuses."

        }

              }
            },
```

```json
          },

            "type": "object",
```

### `ph_composer.windows.types.delete`

Delete Window Type; live references require replacement. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Delete Window Type. Rewrites referring definitions and defaults, then deletes atomically. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.in_use`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_changed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, `window.unknown_type`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.duplicate`

Duplicate a Window Type with independent identity. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Duplicate Window Type. Copies definition metadata and retains shared products; new elements get fresh ids. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^wnt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Window Type to copy."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The copy's name; \"<name> (copy)\" when absent. Names are unique."
    },
    "copy_datasheets": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Keep the datasheet links on the copy; false when absent."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json

  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "id": "wnt_Ab12Cd34Ef56"
```
```json
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.flip`

Mirror the layout left to right, swapping left and right Frames, installs and operation directions. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Flip Window Type. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.insert`

Insert a row or column band at a grid boundary, filled with new glazed elements. Elements spanning that boundary must be split first. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Insert Window Band. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.kind`

Make elements glazed or Empty. Empty is wall area: it clears the elements' Glazing, Frames, installs and operation. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Change Window Element Kind. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.merge`

Merge two or more elements of one kind that cover one rectangle into a single element under a new id. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Merge Window Elements. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.paste`

Copy one glazed element's Glazing, Frames, operation and installs onto other glazed elements. Installs copy only where the edges match. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Paste Window Element. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.remove`

Undo step: Remove Window Band. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_frame`

Set or clear the Frame on one side of one glazed element; the other sides stay. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Set Window Frame. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_name`

Name one element. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Rename Window Element. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_operation`

Set or clear how one glazed element opens. A fixed element has no directions. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Set Window Operation. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "element_id",
    "operation",
    "id",
    "expected_values"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "element_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^wel_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The element, by its id within this Window Type."
    },
    "operation": {
      "type": [
        "object",
        "null"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "type",
        "directions"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "fixed",
            "swing",
            "slide"
          ]
        },
        "directions": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "left",
              "right",
              "up",
              "down"
            ]
          }
        }
```

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.split`

Split one merged element back into one element per grid cell, each under a new id. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Split Window Element. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.installs.save`

Assign Psi-Install Types to the edges of Window Type elements, in one Undo step, with any Psi-Install Types they need created, edited or copied from a library. Each listed element's four sides are replaced as given; null clears a side. A side may name a temporary client_id from psi_install_types.create or imports instead of a saved id. The panel's Installs session and the library assignment both use it; for one edge, list one Type with one element. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Edit Window Installations. Creates or edits installation products and updates type edges atomically. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Calls: `ph_composer.library.copy_into_proposal`.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.callback_invalid`, `library.catalog_stale`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.local_choice_required`, `library.provider_ambiguous`, `library.provider_failed`, `library.provider_invalid`, `library.provider_unavailable`, `library.review_required`, `library.row_semantic_invalid`, `library.row_unavailable`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `operation.proposal_required`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.update`

Edit guarded authored values of one Window Type. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Edit Window Type. Updates one definition and preserves its metadata. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.units.new_flipped_type`

Create a horizontally flipped Type for one mirrored Window. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: New Flipped Window Type. Creates one independent Type; preserves physical panes, metadata and glue. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_changed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.not_mirrored`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "unit"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "unit": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "unit_id",
        "entity_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "unit_id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "entity_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "minItems": 1,
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "The mirrored Window occurrence."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The new Type's name; \"<Type> (flipped)\" when absent."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "unit_id",
    "type_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "unit_id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "type_id": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "unit": {
    "unit_id": "wun_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
    "entity_path": [
      1201,
      1203
    ]
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.units.place`

Place an anchored Window on an explicit writable Zone Face. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Place Window. Creates or reuses the Type definition, glues an instance and stores its Unit record. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_changed`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "host",
    "type_id",
    "anchor",
    "offsets"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "host": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "zone_id",
        "zone_path",
        "entity_path",
        "entity_id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "zone_id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "zone_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "entity_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "entity_id": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "description": "The writable Zone Face to place on."
    },
    "type_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^wnt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Window Type to place."
    },
    "anchor": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "sill_left",
        "sill_center",
        "sill_right",
        "center_left",
        "center",
        "center_right",
        "head_left",
        "head_center",
        "head_right"
      ],
      "description": "Which point of the opening sits at the placement point: sill, center or head, by left, center or right as seen from outside."
    },
    "offsets": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "x_m",
        "y_m"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "x_m": {
          "type": "number",
          "x-unit": "m"
        },
        "y_m": {
          "type": "number",
          "x-unit": "m"
        }
      },
      "description": "Where the anchor goes on the Face, in metres right and up from the Face's lowest, leftmost extent as seen from outside."
    },
    "user_data": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Local JSON metadata kept with the record in the Model. Export needs an explicit mapping; arbitrary metadata is left out with a finding."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "unit_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "unit_id": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "host": {
    "zone_id": "zon_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
    "zone_path": [
      1201
    ],
    "entity_path": [
      1202
    ],
    "entity_id": null
  },
  "type_id": "wnt_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
  "anchor": "sill_center",
  "offsets": {
    "x_m": 1.0,
    "y_m": 0.8
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.units.rehost`

Glue an unmoved Window to an explicit same-storage Face. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Re-host Window. Changes glue only, after containment and overlap checks. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_changed`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.rehost_parent`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "unit",
    "host"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "unit": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "unit_id",
        "entity_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "unit_id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "entity_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "minItems": 1,
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "The Window occurrence to glue."
    },
    "host": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "zone_id",
        "zone_path",
        "entity_path",
        "entity_id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "zone_id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "zone_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "entity_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "entity_id": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "description": "The Face to glue it to, in the same parent storage; the Window must lie on it."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "unit_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "unit_id": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "unit": {
    "unit_id": "wun_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
    "entity_path": [
      1201,
      1203
    ]
  },
  "host": {
    "zone_id": "zon_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
    "zone_path": [
      1201
    ],
    "entity_path": [
      1202
    ],
    "entity_id": null

}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.units.remove`

Remove explicit Window occurrences with reference guards. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Remove Windows. Removes only the chosen instances; incoming references must remain valid. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.zones.solve_adjacency`

Reconcile and pair shared Faces within an explicit Zone scope. Owner: `ph_composer.zones`.

Undo step: Solve Zone Adjacency. Retires old Surface pairs and writes current endpoints.

Refuses: `adjacency.stale`, `adjacency.unresolved`, `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `scope.incomplete`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.same_zone`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "zones"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "zones": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "zone_id",
          "zone_path"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "zone_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "zone_path": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "The Zone occurrences whose shared Faces to pair; Faces shared with a Zone outside the scope are left alone."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "pair_ids",
    "reported"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "pair_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Every Surface pair current after the Solve."
    },
    "reported": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Findings reported instead of paired, as outcome findings."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "zones": [
    {
      "zone_id": "zon_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
      "zone_path": [
        1201
      ]
    },
    {
      "zone_id": "zon_Gh78Ij90Kl12",
      "zone_path": [
        1301
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### `ph_composer.context.open`

Open the Group or Component at the end of path as the edit context, through every one above it. Refuses a locked or missing step. Owner: `ph_composer.context`.

Side effects: Moves the edit path, which advances the Model revision. Leaving a Volume that was open and unprotected protects it again (Spaces locks it). No authored value changes; SketchUp itself records leaving a Group as an Undo entry, and undoing it reopens the Group.

Refuses: `session.inactive`, `target.edit_path_changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, and the `view_command` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "description": "Persistent ids of Groups and Components from the root, outermost first."
    },
    "expected_path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "description": "The edit path as last read; refused when it has changed since."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "path",
    "changed"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "description": "Persistent ids of Groups and Components from the root, outermost first."
    },
    "changed": {
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "path": [
    1201
  ]
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "path": [
    1201,
    1202
  ],
  "expected_path": []
}
```

### `ph_composer.view.capture`

Write a PNG of the current view at the current camera and answer its path, hash and what it shows. Geometry only. Owner: `ph_composer.view`.

Side effects: Writes one image file to a temporary folder; deletes this session's captures older than 15 minutes or beyond the newest four. Nothing in the Model or the view changes.

Needs the `capture` grant rather than `view`.

Refuses: `capture.failed`, `capture.too_large`, `capture.view_changed`, and the `view_command` common set.

```json

  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "width": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 64,
      "maximum": 4096,
      "description": "Pixels; give width and height together, or neither for the viewport's size."
    },
    "height": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 64,
      "maximum": 4096,
      "description": "Pixels; give width and height together, or neither for the viewport's size."
    }
  },
  "required": []
}
```

```json
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "path",
    "sha256",
    "bytes",
    "width",
    "height",
    "captured_at",
    "provenance",
    "overlays"
  ],
  "properties": {
```

### `ph_composer.windows.place_tool.choose`

### `ph_composer.zones.faces.locate`

Bring an explicit set of Faces into view and outline them, leaving the selection alone. Owner: `ph_composer.zones`.

Side effects: Moves the camera to frame the Faces and outlines them until the selection changes. The edit path, the selection and the revision are unchanged.

Refuses: only the `view_command` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "faces"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "faces": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "zone_id",
          "zone_path",
          "entity_path",
          "entity_id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "zone_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "zone_path": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          },
          "entity_path": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          },
          "entity_id": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "The Face occurrences to bring into view and outline."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "found",
    "missing"
  ],

}

}
```

## File exports

Called with a context granted `export`.

### `ph_composer.library.export_file`

Write local definitions to a library file the user chooses in the native save dialog; export_preview shows what it will hold. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Needs the user: the panel or menu asks for a destination file first. Any other caller passes `location`, the id of a location the user approved, or is refused with `access.user_required`.

Refuses: `export.replace_required`, `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.catalog_too_many_rows`, `library.destination_changed`, `library.destination_invalid`, `library.export_write_failed`, `library.file_malformed`, `library.file_too_large`, `library.format_invalid`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.schema_unsupported`, `library.update_destination_invalid`, `library.update_destination_required`, `record.unreadable`, `revision.stale`, `target.not_found`, and the `file_export` and `approval` and `location` common sets.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "all",
        "selected"
      ],
      "description": "all, the default, takes every supported local definition; selected takes only records."
    },
    "identity": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "new",
        "update"
      ],
      "description": "new, the default, gives the file a new library id; update keeps the id of the library file being replaced."
    },
    "kinds": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Limit the export to these library kinds, such as materials."
    },
    "records": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "record_kind",
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "record_kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "With scope selected: the records to export, each by record kind and id."
    },
    "library_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library name written into the file. Defaults to Model library, or to the replaced file's name for update."
    },
    "expected_revision": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "The Model revision export_preview reported; refused if the Model changed since."
    },
    "projection_digest": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The projection_digest export_preview reported; refused if what would be written differs. Required to replace a file at an approved location."
    },
    "location": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The id of a location the user approved, from ph_composer.locations.list."
        },
        "replace": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Consent to replace what the destination holds. Needs expected_destination."
        },
        "expected_destination": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The destination state a preview reported, so a destination that changed since is refused."
        }
      },
      "description": "An approved location to use instead of asking the user. A native client asks instead."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "kinds",
    "omissions",
    "library_id",
    "library_name",
    "identity",
    "written"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "kinds": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "kind",
          "record_kind_label",
          "count"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "record_kind_label": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "description": "The registered record kind's label, for display; kind and record_kind stay the identifiers."
          },
          "count": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 0
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "omissions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "record_kind",
          "record_kind_label",
          "fields",
          "reason"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "record_kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "record_kind_label": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "description": "The registered record kind's label, for display; kind and record_kind stay the identifiers."
          },
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "fields": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            }
          },
          "reason": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "library_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "library_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "identity": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "new",
        "update"
      ]
    },
    "written": {
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  }
}
```

## Proposal participants

Called by no client. An action of a feature that requires the owner names the participant in its `participants` and calls it inside its own proposal; its refusals are included in that action's.

### `ph_composer.library.copy_into_proposal`

Copy or reuse one library record, with optional assignment, inside the calling action's own proposal and Undo step. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.callback_invalid`, `library.catalog_stale`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.local_choice_required`, `library.provider_ambiguous`, `library.provider_failed`, `library.provider_invalid`, `library.provider_unavailable`, `library.review_required`, `library.row_semantic_invalid`, `library.row_unavailable`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `participant` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "provider_id",
    "kind",
    "generation",
    "library_id",
    "record_id",
    "choice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "provider_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "A configured library, by the id ph_composer.library.providers lists."
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library kind, such as materials or frames; providers lists the kinds each library serves."
    },
    "generation": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The catalog generation the caller read. Omit it to use the current one; a stale one is refused as library.catalog_stale."
    },
    "library_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library holding the row, as the catalog row gives it."
    },
    "record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The row's record id within that library."
    },
    "choice": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "create",
        "keep_local",
        "use_library"
      ],
      "description": "create copies the row as a new local record; keep_local reuses a reviewed local candidate unchanged; use_library replaces a reviewed candidate's values with the library's. Read the resolution first with in_file or a preview."
    },
    "local_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The reviewed local candidate for keep_local or use_library, from the resolution's candidates. May be omitted when there is exactly one."
    },
    "expected_values": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "For use_library: the candidate's expected_values from the resolution. Refused when the local record changed since."
    },
    "assignment": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional: where the owning feature also assigns the copied record, in that kind's assignment target shape, such as one Window Type element side."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.zones.stamp_container`

Stamp a Group the calling action's own earlier step creates inside a Zone occurrence, making it a nested container of that Zone. The step leaves the Group's root-to-Group path in its slot as entity_path. Owner: `ph_composer.zones`.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `participant` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "zone",
    "slot"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "zone": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "zone_id",
        "zone_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "zone_id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "zone_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "The Zone occurrence the container is inside."
    },
    "slot": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The proposal slot the calling step fills with the new Group's entity_path."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "zone_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "zone_id": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "zone": {
    "zone_id": "zon_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
    "zone_path": [
      1201
    ]
  },
  "slot": "spc_Ab12Cd34Ef56"
}
```

## Export tasks

HBJSON runtime exports use retained task methods. Each params key is the method's keyword argument.

```json
}
```

### `PhComposer::API.start_export`

Start one export of the canonical HBJSON and its report to a destination the user approved (ph_composer.locations.approve_destination). An existing pair is replaced only with replace and the expected_destination export_preflight reported; one task runs per Model at a time. Needs `export`.

Keyword arguments besides context:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "location"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "location": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The id of a location the user approved, from ph_composer.locations.list."
        },
        "replace": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Consent to replace what the destination holds. Needs expected_destination."
        },
        "expected_destination": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The destination state a preview reported, so a destination that changed since is refused."
        }
      },
      "description": "An approved location to use instead of asking the user. A native client asks instead."
    }
  }
}
```

Result value:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "task_id",
    "stage",
    "count",
    "cancellable",
    "outcome"

        },

          ]

          "description": "When completed: the compact result and, for a start from an approved location, that location's id and label. Only the caller that started the task, once the pair is written, also gets artifacts.",
          "properties": {
            "artifacts": {
              "type": "object",
              "required": [
                "run_id",
                "source_revision",
                "export_generation",
                "hbjson",
                "report"
              ],
              "description": "Where the written pair is and what its bytes hash to, for the caller that started the task only. Read the files with your own tools and compare the SHA-256 before parsing: a later export to the same destination replaces them.",
              "properties": {
                "run_id": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "source_revision": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "export_generation": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "location": {
                  "type": [
                    "object",
                    "null"
                  ]
                },
                "hbjson": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "required": [
                    "path",
                    "sha256",
                    "bytes"
                  ],
                  "properties": {
                    "path": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "sha256": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "bytes": {
                      "type": "integer"
                    }
                  }
                },
                "report": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "required": [

                    "bytes"
                  ],
                  "properties": {

            }

        },
```

## Feature codes

The codes each feature raises under its own noun, as an outcome's `code` or a finding's. The foundation's and the shared nouns' codes are listed in context/CONTRACTS.md, "Outcomes and codes".

### `ph_composer.agent_access`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `agent_access.limit` | This machine already has the most live agent tokens it keeps; revoke one first. |
| `agent_access.model_changed` | The open Model changed since the form showed it; nothing was issued. |
| `agent_access.model_unsaved` | A token can be bound only to a Model that has been saved to a file. |
| `agent_access.store_unavailable` | The agent tokens could not be read or saved on this machine. |
| `agent_access.store_unreadable` | The stored agent tokens cannot be read; reset them before issuing another. |
| `agent_access.token_unknown` | No agent token has that id on this machine. |

### `ph_composer.assemblies`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `assembly.calculation_limit` | The exact thermal calculation exceeds its path budget; no value is given. |
| `assembly.geometry_invalid` | A Layer thickness, Layer-Segment width or steel-stud spacing is not positive. |
| `assembly.invalid` | The Assembly record does not satisfy its schema. |
| `assembly.material_dangling` | A Layer-Segment names a Material that is not in the Model. |
| `assembly.membrane_in_mixed_layer` | A Layer holding a membrane has more than one Layer-Segment. |
| `assembly.no_thermal_layers` | Every Layer is a membrane, so no U-value can be calculated. |
| `assembly.segment_unassigned` | A Layer-Segment has no Material. |
| `assembly.thermal_layer_limit` | The Assembly has more thermal Layers than a Honeybee OpaqueConstruction holds. |
| `material.conductivity_missing` | A non-membrane Material has no conductivity. |
| `material.invalid` | The Material record does not satisfy its schema. |
| `material.specific_heat_too_low` | A Material's specific heat is below the Honeybee minimum. |
| `material.thermal_mass_defaulted` | A Material has no density or specific heat; export uses disclosed defaults. |

## API changes

| Version | Date | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1.1 | 2026-10-18 | describe adds capability, preview_capability, a view command's side_effects, preconditions and a query's response and while_busy; discover adds schemas; ph_composer.context.read is new. |
| 1.2 | 2026-10-18 | ph_composer.spaces.list answers bounded summaries with fields, the Model's sums before any filter and the sums of the page's Zones and Building-Segments; spaces.volumes.list, spaces.floor_segments.list and spaces.findings.list are new, Floor Segment loops only when fields asks. |
| 1.3 | 2026-10-18 | ph_composer.spaces.candidate_faces.list is new; spaces.update and spaces.batch_update type values and expected_values by field, with units, and refuse unknown keys at the schema. |
| 1.4 | 2026-10-18 | ph_composer.context.open and ph_composer.context.root are new view commands; the Spaces context commands and both locate commands declare side_effects. |
| 1.5 | 2026-10-18 | ph_composer.context.read answers the camera; the view generation also advances when the camera changes. |
| 1.6 | 2026-10-18 | The Outcome schema gains an optional sequence, set only by the agent connection's invoke and outcome results. |
| 1.7 | 2026-10-18 | export_status and latest_export give the caller that started a task its written pair's paths, SHA-256 and sizes as outcome.value.artifacts. |
| 1.8 | 2026-10-18 | The capture capability and ph_composer.view.capture are new; describe names the grant a view command declares when it is not view. |
| 1.9 | 2026-10-21 | ph_composer.view.capture no longer answers window_state: every window state measured gives the current view. |
| 1.10 | 2026-10-25 | ph_composer.thermal_bridges is new: the Thermal Bridge Type kind, types.list, types.all and its snapshot section, and types.create, types.update, types.duplicate and types.delete. |
| 1.11 | 2026-10-25 | ph_composer.zones.containment is new. ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.assign, edges.clear, edges.selection (bounded), edges.selection_all and the edges.selected snapshot section are new, over the ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edge reference target; types.delete takes replacement_id. |
